Aditya Enterprises (AEM), established in 2008 by Mr. Azad Jain and Aditya Jain (B.Tech, Mechanical Engineering), is a steel fabrication and industrial manufacturing company serving customers across India. The company operates a 100% in-house facility covering fabrication, machining, finishing and assembly. Its products and services include heavy steel fabrication, sheet metal components, stainless steel industrial furniture, work tables, lockers, lab cupboards, storage racks, material handling equipment, office furniture, tool cabinets, pallets and bins, PEB structures, machining work, repair and coating services and conveyor or shredding machine solutions.

Coating and machining:
- Plasma coating service: plasma spray coating of rollers, sleeves, plates and machine parts for wear, corrosion and anti-stick protection (https://adityaaem.in/category/plasma-coating)
- Rubber coating service: rubber coating and re-rubberising of rollers, sleeves and machine parts, including food-grade white rubber (https://adityaaem.in/category/rubber-coating)
- Machining items: CNC and lathe machined components in aluminium, SS, nylon and PTFE such as plates, housings, timing pulleys, gears, guides and PTFE hose separators (https://adityaaem.in/category/machining-work)

Industries served include cement, power plants, automobile, metal construction, chemical, rubber, oil and gas, food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, textile, banking and architectural fabrication.

Aditya Enterprises focuses on custom fabrication to drawing, material grade selection, timely delivery and dependable after-sales support with a strong emphasis on quality and industrial application suitability.
